articles.title: Eraaya Lifespaces renamed as Ebix Limited to align with global brand
articles.description: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited has officially changed its name to Ebix Limited after receiving approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. The rebranding aligns the corporate identity with its global operating platform and international brand identity following the acquisition of Ebix Inc. The company operates across technology, payments, travel, and emerging businesses in 13 countries.

articles.title: ideaForge Technology seeks ₹5,000 crore fund raising via postal ballot
articles.description: ideaForge Technology Limited has scheduled a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for raising up to ₹5,000 million through various securities, including equity shares and debentures. The e-voting period is open from June 5, 2026, to July 4, 2026, with a cut-off date of May 29, 2026. Additionally, the company proposes amending its Articles of Association to align the definition of "Promoter" with SEBI ICDR Regulations.

articles.title: India blocks China’s first request to setup WTO dispute panel in IT, solar measures
articles.description: India has blocked China's initial request for a World Trade Organization dispute panel. China alleges India's tariffs and incentives unfairly target its information technology and solar energy imports. India maintains its measures align with global trade rules. China can renew its request at a future meeting. This dispute highlights trade tensions between the two nations.

articles.title: Invisalign maker Align Technology to invest Rs 1,800 crore in Hyderabad plant
articles.description: US firm Align Technology will invest Rs 1,800 crore in Hyderabad for its first Indian manufacturing plant. This facility will be the company's fourth globally. It is expected to create over 300 jobs. The investment will boost Align Technology's existing operations in the city. The new plant will support its worldwide production of clear aligners.
